role: Training Load detail screen (ACR gauge, ATL/CTL/TSB, ACWR zone legend, Foster monotony banner, recent workouts) plus shared TrainingLoadVisibility gate and TrainingLoadPausedCard used by other load screens.
types: TrainingDetailView: struct View — training-load detail page fed a live TrainingMetrics and/or frozen TrainingContext
TrainingDetailView.LoadMetrics: struct — atl/ctl/tsb/acr tuple normalised from either source
TrainingLoadVisibility: enum — isPaused(settings) gate shared by load screens and the AI system prompt
TrainingLoadPausedCard: struct View — placeholder card shown while load is off / on break
MetricColumn: private struct View — label/value/subtitle column
ACRGaugeBar: private struct View — linear 0.5–2.0 ACR gauge with 4 coloured bands and a thumb
ZoneRow: private struct View — one ACWR band legend row
state: @State isRefreshing: Bool (TrainingDetailView, re-entrancy guard for runRefresh)
followsLiveLoad: Bool = false (TrainingDetailView, caller-set: show the shared TrainingMetricsCache when no metrics are passed)
toplevel: Stored lets trainingMetrics/trainingContext and var followsLiveLoad (default false) set by the caller; #Preview builds the view with both nil. MetricColumn/ZoneRow/ACRGaugeBar are memberwise-initialised private structs.

flags.text: The only test (ComponentSnapshotTests) renders TrainingDetailView with live metrics and no context, the path production never takes; the frozen-context path the app uses is not snapshotted.

Memberwise designated init storing atl, ctl, tsb, acr.
The live metrics on screen: trainingMetrics when passed, else TrainingMetricsCache.current when followsLiveLoad, else nil. Observed, so a cache refresh re-renders the screen.
